atts.text: Humanity spends its lifecycles inside dense atmospheric envelopes, trapped by architectural density and local noise. Vertex shifts the anchor point upward, establishing a platform where external space and interior focus intersect cleanly.
By scaling the highest summits of the mind, cloud tiers become placeholders for the noise you leave behind.
